gen-vast-shadow-gf-preahvihear: Retro and loud, Vast Shadow cuts every stroke to a single ruled width, while Preahvihear below it opens its letters wide like a pried oyster shell. Lofty and modern.
gen-vast-shadow-gf-prompt: Bent-tubing letters, vintage and hard to ignore, make up Vast Shadow, with the same gauge in every curve. Prompt takes over below with oversized small letters, so its size can stay modest beside the heading.
gen-vast-shadow-gf-pt-sans-caption: Vast Shadow looks like tubing bent into letters, vintage and loud. PT Sans Caption follows with big-bodied lowercase and unclosed bowls, so a long stretch of text feels inviting and steady.
gen-vast-shadow-gf-puritan: Vintage tubing-thick lines give Vast Shadow its punch, with diagonals carrying as much heft as the stems. And Puritan, a plain sans of rounded forms, is where the heading earns its keep: big and short.
gen-vast-shadow-gf-questrial: Questrial brings flat, stencil-cut single-weight strokes and open c, e and s shapes, tall in the band of its lowercase. Vast Shadow, vintage and eye-catching above it, makes that sans feel even more modern.
gen-vast-shadow-gf-radio-canada: Tall, spaced-out letters cut at one width define Vast Shadow. It carries the vintage showmanship, while Radio Canada, a plain sans with full c, s and z, does the quiet, steady work of being read.
gen-vast-shadow-gf-radio-canada-big: Eye-catching and a bit vintage, Vast Shadow draws every stroke at one width with plenty of space around each letter. And Radio Canada Big fills the line with a tall x-height and terminals that finish clear of the stem.
gen-vast-shadow-gf-readex-pro: Readex Pro is all broad terminal gaps and a steady weight from word to word. Vast Shadow, vintage and cut at one width above it, makes that sans-serif feel even more composed.
gen-vast-shadow-gf-roboto: Vast Shadow traces each stroke at the width of one stylus, vintage and eye-catching. Roboto, a clean sans with generous mouths on its rounds, would feel oversized if the heading shrank too small.
gen-vast-shadow-gf-ruda: Ruda is a wire-like sans-serif with wide-mouthed rounds. Its sizable x-height keeps screen text easy, and Vast Shadow's vintage, single-width letters give it a showy partner.
